selection_rule: Reuse exactly the historical 100-event pilot identity roster; no new selection, duration cut, fit or ranking.

crossmatch_rule.coordinate_algorithm: Spherical atan2 great-circle separation on printed J2000 coordinates.
crossmatch_rule.coordinate_cautions: Static published source coordinates, no proper-motion propagation or crowded-field lens/source association claim.

eligible_historical_followups.absence_qualification: No further specific alias/parallax/lens-interpretation paper was located by these bounded queries; this does not establish absence or newness.

primary_Yock2008_assessment.coverage_caution: The authors report no collaboration obtained observations during the event FWHM.
primary_Yock2008_assessment.actual_scope: Preliminary planetary-sensitivity/coverage report, not a measurement of this lens mass or thetaE.

additional_native_data_version_inventory.existing_EWS_fit_metadata: Prior fit summaries only, not additional observations or mass constraints.

prior_PAR07_context.qualification: Conditional population/Gaia-prior posterior; not a direct mass measurement to import into pilot likelihood
prior_PAR07_context.scope: Historical prior-dependent reanalysis, not observations or new BHSM fit

forward_identification_limits: Validated unresolved annual-parallax photometry can constrain piE, tE and projected velocity; it does not measure thetaE by itself.
M=thetaE/(kappa*piE) requires independently identified angular scale or a separately declared prior; long duration is not a measured mass.
No measured lens mass, distance, horizon scale, core/envelope deformation or BH truth label has been added for either target.
BHSM interpretation uses the ordinary single gravitational optical potential in the stated exterior regime; no extra core/envelope lensing potential is introduced.
Historical catalog matches identify already published source events, not compact-lens identity or source/lens separation in a crowded field.
No publication/data-contact communication, new fit, alert or discovery claim was performed.
